ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric blobs centered in both lobes, bordered by a dense black periphery. The left lobe contains a vertical dark linear feature through the white region. The right lobe contains several small circular dark clusters within the white region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 42 degrees; the depth is partially obscured by the waterline but shows sharp convergence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge with peak amplitudes between 5-15 pixels. Extreme serration and irregular notches are noted on the distal portion of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinctly concave curve fitted from the median notch extending to the lateral tips on both visible lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dark pixel clusters observed within the white field of the right lobe lobe, approximately at mid-span.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent near-vertical dark linear disruption visible on the medial portion of the left lobe white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular serration and potential tissue loss on the outer margin of the right fluke lobe trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: The right fluke tip exhibits a prominent upward-hooked geometric contour relative to the left lobe tip.
